title: Listen API: Podcast Search, Directory, and Insights API

operations.description: Podcast hosting services can use this endpoint to streamline the process of podcast deletion on behave of their users (podcasters). We will review the deletion request within 12 hours. If the podcast is already deleted, the "status" field in the response will be "deleted". Otherwise, the status field will be "in review". If you want to get a notification once the podcast is deleted, you can configure a webhook url in the dashboard: listennotes.com/api/dashboard/#webhooks
operations.summary: Request to delete a podcast
operations.T: [METHOD] delete [NAME] delete podcast by id [PATH] podcasts [PARAMS] id key listen reason x [SCHEMA] delete found not podcast response

operations.description:
Get a list of curated best podcasts by genre,
which are curated by Listen Notes staffs based on various signals from the Internet, e.g.,
top charts on other podcast platforms, recommendations from mainstream media,
user activities on listennotes.com...
You can get the genre ids from `GET /genres` endpoint.
This endpoint returns same data as https://www.listennotes.com/best-podcasts/
operations.summary: Fetch a list of best podcasts by genre
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] best podcasts [PATH] best podcasts [PARAMS] genre id key language listen mode page publisher region safe sort x [SCHEMA] audio avg best claimed country date description earliest email episode episodes explicit extra field for found frequency genre global hours i id ids image is language latest length listen ln looking ms name not podcast podcasts pub publisher rank response rss score sec simple thumbnail total tunes type update url website

operations.description: A bunch of curated lists from online media. For each list, you'll get basic info of up to 5 podcasts. To get detailed meta data of all podcasts in a specific list, you need to use `GET /curated_podcasts/{id}`. We add new curated lists to the database on a daily basis.
operations.summary: Fetch curated lists of podcasts
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] curated podcasts [PATH] curated podcasts [PARAMS] key listen page x [SCHEMA] curated date description domain field id list ln minimum ms name podcast podcasts pub response simple source total url

operations.description:
Get detailed meta data of all podcasts in a specific curated list.
This endpoint returns same data as https://www.listennotes.com/curated-podcasts/

operations.description:
Get a list of podcast genres that are supported in Listen Notes.
The genre id can be passed to other endpoints as a parameter to get podcasts in a specific genre,
e.g., `GET /best_podcasts`, `GET /search`...
You may want to cache the list of genres on the client side.
operations.summary: Fetch a list of podcast genres
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] genres [PATH] genres [PARAMS] key level listen only top x [SCHEMA] genre genres response

operations.description: Recently published episodes are more likely to be fetched. Good luck!
operations.summary: Fetch a random podcast episode
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] just listen [PATH] just listen [PARAMS] key listen x [SCHEMA] audio date description edit episode explicit field global id image invalid length link listen ln maybe minimum ms name podcast pub publisher rank score sec simple thumbnail url

operations.description: Get a list of languages that are supported in Listen Notes database. You can use the language string as query parameter in `GET /search`.
operations.summary: Fetch a list of supported languages for podcasts
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] languages [PATH] languages [PARAMS] key listen x [SCHEMA] languages response

operations.description:
This endpoint returns same data as listennotes.com/listen under your account.
You can use the **page** parameter to do pagination and fetch more playlists.
operations.summary: Fetch a list of your playlists.
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] playlists [PATH] playlists [PARAMS] key listen page sort x [SCHEMA] description field id image last listennotes ms name playlist playlists response thumbnail timestamp url visibility

operations.description:
A playlist can be an episode list (i.e., all items are episodes) or a podcast list (i.e., all items are podcasts),
which is essentially the same as those created via listennotes.com/listen/.
This endpoint fetches a list of items (i.e., episodes or podcasts) in the playlist.
You can use the **last_pub_date_ms** parameter to do pagination and fetch more items.
A playlist can be **public** (discoverable on ListenNotes.com),
**unlisted** (accessible to anyone who knows the playlist id),
or **private** (accessible to its owner).
You can fetch all playlists created by you, and **public** / **unlisted** playlists created by others.
operations.summary: Fetch a playlist's info and items (i.e., episodes or podcasts).
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] playlist by id [PATH] playlists [PARAMS] id key last listen ms sort timestamp type x [SCHEMA] description field found id image item last listennotes ms name not playlist response thumbnail timestamp url visibility

operations.description:
Fetch podcasts by a publisher's domain name, e.g., nytimes.com, wondery.com, npr.org...
Each request will return up to 10 podcasts. You can use the `page` parameter to paginate.

operations.description: Suggest related search terms. The results are more comprehensive than from `GET /typeahead`. This endpoint is available only in the PRO/ENTERPRISE plan.
operations.summary: Fetch related search terms
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] related searches [PATH] related searches [PARAMS] key listen q x [SCHEMA] bad related request response searches

operations.description:
Full-text search on episodes, podcasts, or curated lists of podcasts.
Use the `offset` parameter to paginate through search results.
The FREE plan allows to see up to 30 search results (or `offset` < 30) per query.
The PRO plan allows to see up to 300 search results (or `offset` < 300) per query.
The ENTERPRISE plan allows to see up to 10,000 search results (or `offset` < 10000) per query.
operations.summary: Full-text search
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] search [PATH] search [PARAMS] after before by count date episode freq genre ids in key language len listen max min mode ncid ocid offset only page podcasts published q region safe size sort type unique update x [SCHEMA] bad curated episode list podcast request response result search

operations.description: Suggest a list of words that correct the spelling errors of a search term. This endpoint is available only in the PRO/ENTERPRISE plan.
operations.summary: Spell check on a search term
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] spellcheck [PATH] spellcheck [PARAMS] key listen q x [SCHEMA] bad check request response spell

operations.description: Batch fetch basic meta data for up to 10 episodes. This endpoint could be used to implement custom playlists for individual episodes. For detailed meta data of an individual episode, you need to use `GET /episodes/{id}`. This endpoint is available only in the PRO/ENTERPRISE plan.
operations.summary: Batch fetch basic meta data for episodes
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME] episodes in batch [PATH] episodes [PARAMS] key listen x [SCHEMA] audio batch date description edit episode episodes explicit field form id image in invalid length link ln maybe minimum ms name podcast pub response sec simple thumbnail url

operations.description:
Batch fetch basic meta data for up to 10 podcasts.
This endpoint could be used to build something like OPML import,
allowing users to import a bunch of podcasts via rss urls.
For detailed meta data (including episodes) of an individual podcast, you need to use `GET /podcasts/{id}`. This endpoint is available only in the PRO/ENTERPRISE plan.
operations.summary: Batch fetch basic meta data for podcasts
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME] podcasts in batch [PATH] podcasts [PARAMS] key listen x [SCHEMA] audio avg batch claimed country date description earliest edit email episode episodes explicit extra field for form frequency genre global hours i id ids image in invalid is language latest length link listen ln looking maybe minimum ms name podcast podcasts pub publisher rank response rss score sec simple thumbnail total tunes type update url website

operations.description: Podcast hosting services can use this endpoint to help your users directly submit a new podcast to Listen Notes database. If the podcast doesn't exist in the database, "status" in the response will be "in review", and we'll review it within 12 hours. If the podcast exists, "status" in the response will be "found". If this submission is rejected, "status" in the response will be "rejected". You can use `POST /podcasts` to check if multiple podcasts exist in the database. If you want to get a notification once the podcast is accepted, you can either specify the "email" parameter or configure a webhook url in the dashboard: listennotes.com/api/dashboard/#webhooks
operations.summary: Submit a podcast to Listen Notes database
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME] submit podcast [PATH] podcasts submit [PARAMS] key listen x [SCHEMA] bad field form global id image listen ln minimum name podcast publisher rank request response score submit thumbnail url
